# IPCs
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to major gameplay changes![/color]
IPC, or Integrated Positronic Chassis, is an old chassis model from a time before the specialized chassis of today, they are designed for flexibility.
## Racial Features - Their "blood" is actually oil and thus [color=#ffa500]will never clot on its own[/color]. - Due to not being organic, chemicals don't work on them, and their "doctor" is a roboticist. Welding heals physical injuries, cables fix burn damage, glass fixes their eyes, plasma fixes radiation and Oil packs restore their "blood". - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - They have an internal Headset! It has two slots, one already taken up by their [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Key[/color]. - They [color=#1e90ff]don't need to eat or drink[/color], but they do [color=#ffa500]need to stay charged[/color]. They can take power directly from APCs or sit in a borg recharger. - Due to their fragile internal components, they receive [color=#ffa500]50% more shock damage[/color] and [color=#ffa500]20% more blunt damage[/color] - Additionally, they receive [color=#1fb0ff]30% less slash and piercing damage[/color]. - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - They [color=#1fb0ff]do not need to breathe[/color] but will overheat quickly if there is no atmosphere and they do not have a cooling fan. - They are [color=#1fb0ff]immune to barotrauma[/color]. - They can easily withstand temperatures below 100 degrees Celcius, standard body temperature may vary depending on internal components. - EMPs are almost always [color=red]lethal[/color] to them, as they will shut down 5 to 10 seconds after being hit by one - Due to having their brain inside their torso, they [color=#1e90ff]can survive losing their head[/color] but will be unable to speak or see without it. - Their fists deal [color=red]6[/color] blunt damage with unarmed attacks.
## Trinary IPCs are able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics. They are also able to understand other silicon's encoded messages.
## Origins and Names No one knows what exactly causes an artificial intelligence to gain sapience, the technology to support their processes has been available for centuries yet new AIs seem to be created out of nowhere. When a new AI comes online, they either ask to be named by their creator or already have a name chosen for themself. They do not seem to follow any particular naming scheme.
